issues.title: Non-emergent events are left blank where Define-XML assigns N
issues.summary: Define-XML sets TRTEMFL='N' for events that are not treatment emergent; the specification and the submission program adae.r leave those events blank, as the reference does.
issues.expected: Define-XML: If ASTDT >= TRTSDT > . then TRTEMFL='Y'. Otherwise TRTEMFL='N'.
issues.observed: The specification's otherwise branch is blank; adae.r lines 125-133 call admiral derive_var_trtemfl, which sets only Y. The N branch differs from the reference on 65 of 1191 records; the blank reading matches.
issues.action: Decide whether non-emergent events carry N or no value, then correct Define-XML, or the specification and the program, so all three state the same false branch.

issues.title: Define-XML query text misspells the SOC and differs from the program
issues.summary: Define-XML spells the CQ01NAM SOC 'SKIN AND SUBC UTANEOUS TISSUE DISORDERS' and excludes three terms by exact match; adae.r matches 'SUBCUTANEOUS' and excludes by substring.
issues.expected: Define-XML: OR if AEBODSYS='SKIN AND SUBC UTANEOUS TISSUE DISORDERS' but AEDECOD is not in ('COLD SWEAT', 'HYPERHIDROSIS', 'ALOPECIA'). The ADRG calls CQ01NAM the dermatologic query.
issues.observed: adae.r lines 202-210 test str_detect(AEBODSYS, "SKIN AND SUBCUTANEOUS TISSUE DISORDERS") and exclude by substring. Define as written differs on 181 of 1191 records; without the SOC blank it matches.
issues.action: Correct the SOC spelling in Define-XML and state whether the three exclusions are exact preferred terms or substrings, so Define-XML and the program state one rule.

issues.title: Specification replaces the documented query with a fixed preferred-term list
issues.summary: Define-XML derives CQ01NAM from AEDECOD substrings, an AEBODSYS condition and three exclusions; the specification instead tests membership in a fixed list of preferred terms.
issues.expected: Flag AEDECOD containing APPLICATION, DERMATITIS, ERYTHEMA or BLISTER, or AEBODSYS skin and subcutaneous tissue disorders unless AEDECOD is COLD SWEAT, HYPERHIDROSIS or ALOPECIA.
issues.observed: The specification tests AE.AEDECOD IN a fixed list of preferred terms. It never reads AEBODSYS and states no exclusion; the three excluded terms are simply absent from the list.
issues.action: Replace the fixed list with the documented substring, SOC and exclusion conditions, or document the list as the intended query definition and justify it.

issues.title: Define-XML subsets AOCC01FL to an empty query name instead of dermatologic events
issues.summary: Define-XML subsets to CQ01NAM='' yet names the flag the first dermatological event; the ADRG, the specification and adae.r select CQ01NAM='DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS'.
issues.expected: Define-XML purpose and ADRG pages 11-12: flag the first treatment-emergent dermatological event within each subject, ordered by ASTDT, then AESEQ.
issues.observed: Define-XML says Subset to CQ01NAM=''. DERM_RN and adae.r lines 213-221 filter CQ01NAM == "DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS". The literal subset differs on 327 of 1191 records; the dermatologic reading matches.
issues.action: Correct the AOCC01FL method in Define-XML to CQ01NAM='DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS', keeping TRTEMFL='Y' and the ASTDT, AESEQ order.

citations.quote: Flag First Treatment Emergent Dermatological Event for Time to Event Analysis

issues.title: Dermatologic first-event ordering adds a study partition and nulls-last placement
issues.summary: DERM_RN groups by STUDYID as well as USUBJID and sorts missing ASTDT last; the retained method names only the USUBJID partition and no missing-value placement.
issues.expected: The retained method flags the first record within USUBJID, ordered by ASTDT, then AESEQ; it states no STUDYID partition and no placement of missing start dates.
issues.observed: DERM_RN lists STUDYID first in group_by and gives the ASTDT order nulls: last. Neither choice appears in a retained document.
issues.action: Confirm the STUDYID partition and nulls-last placement as intended rules and document them, or remove them from the specification.

issues.title: No retained document section states the source of STUDYID
issues.summary: The verifier found no retained document stating how STUDYID is derived; the specification copies AE.STUDYID, as adae.r does. The adjudicator disputes the finding.
issues.expected: A retained document states the source. The adjudicator notes Define-XML IT.ADAE.STUDYID gives a Predecessor origin ADSL.STUDYID, which the reviewed section omits.
issues.observed: The specification derives STUDYID as AE.STUDYID; adae.r reads AE at line 32 and keeps STUDYID as a key for merging ADSL variables at lines 80-85.
issues.action: Confirm whether the Define-XML Predecessor origin ADSL.STUDYID documents this variable; if it does, bring it into the reviewed section, otherwise document the AE source.

issues.title: End-date completion to month 01 and day 01 is not documented
issues.summary: The specification completes partial AEENDTC dates with month 1 and day 1; no retained document states an end-date imputation.
issues.expected: The retained end-date method states only conversion of AEENDTC; the ADRG imputation policy applies to ASTDT.
issues.observed: The specification imputes AENDT from AE.AEENDTC with month: 1 and day: 1, so a year-only end date gets a value. The finding notes adae.r lines 101-106 complete no date part.
issues.action: Remove the month and day completion from AENDT, or document it as the intended end-date imputation rule.
